text:
anika: Quick sync request. AWS marketplace lead (marketplace-id MKT-4321) just came in for BetaFoods. SI partner "BlueForge" also claims BetaFoods via their intake email this morning. How do we credit co-sell and who should own the commercial motion?

devon: Important nuance: marketplace leads come with different entitlements (marketplace referral fee + marketplace-sourced SLA). Historically we treated marketplace-origin leads as owned by sales, but partners expect referral credit if they influenced the introduction.

lila: Can we define a "co-sell score" that weights origin, partner-intent, and engagement? Eg: origin_score (marketplace=0.6, partner=0.7, inbound=0.5) + evidence_score (signed-intent=0.3, email-thread=0.15, PO=0.5) + engagement_score (first_meeting=0.4, technical_survey=0.2). Higher score wins.

raj: I'm wary of too much math. Keep it simple for engineering: compute co_sell_score in [0,1] and choose owner by highest score. Also add a manual override flag for enterprise accounts > $200k ARR.

frank: Suggest baseline policy: marketplace-origin leads default to Sales-Marketplace squad for outreach. If an SI submits evidence within 48h that they sourced the contact (email chain with customer + signed intent), mark as Partner-Led and assign partner-credit. Otherwise marketplace team owns motion.

anika: 48h window sounds fair. For simultaneous claims (both submit evidence) we need rules for revenue credit splits and who runs first-stage negotiations.

devon: For splits propose: evidence-weighted split. If both provide signed intent, split referral credit proportional to evidence_score. For operational simplicity cap splits to 80/20 thresholds (min 20% to secondary). But the owning team runs the commercial ops.

lila: Operational items: 1) intake form must include "origin_channel" (marketplace|partner|inbound); 2) add "evidence_link" field; 3) add "co_sell_score" output on ticket.

raj: Engineering note: we can add a lightweight microservice that listens to intake webhooks and annotates lead records with origin_normalized, partner_claim_ts, evidence_type, and computed co_sell_score. That will drive routing. ETA 2 sprints.

ops-bot: Created ticket PARTNER-812: implement marketplace-partner-crediting-flow (assignee: raj).

frank: Also a PR/announcement concern: partner-run joint announcements require 14-day embargo coordination. Marketplace promotions need separate scheduling. We should not promise public joint launch until contract/crediting resolved.

anika: Add a rule: no public joint announcement until commercial ownership and crediting are marked final in CRM. Required fields: owner_id, crediting_tags, announcement_window.

devon: Add customer consent checkbox for joint PR when we capture lead if partner suggests co-sell. Saves time later.

lila: For edge cases: if account is existing customer (renewal/expansion), existing account owner keeps motion but partner gets referral credit only if they introduced a net-new seat and provide evidence.

raj: Pseudocode for routing (simple):
```
incoming_lead L
compute origin_score, evidence_score, engagement_score
co_sell_score = normalize(origin_score + evidence_score + engagement_score)
if account.is_existing and account.owner != null then owner = account.owner
else if co_sell_score >= 0.7 then owner = partner_assigned(L.partner)
else if L.origin == 'marketplace' then owner = sales_marketplace_queue
else owner = sales_general_queue
```

frank: Let's also track metrics: % leads auto-assigned, % manual adjudications, time-to-decision, partner-satisfaction NPS after handoff.

anika: I'll create a short FAQ for partners explaining the 48h evidence window, what counts as evidence (email with customer @domain, signed referral MSA, PO, or customer confirmation email), and PR coordination rules.

devon: Can Partnerships team run a 6-week pilot for US marketplace leads only, measure impact, then expand.

ops-bot: Note: PARTNER-812 created with label pilot-us-mkt.

anika: Thanks. Raj, please add the schema change for intake webhook and a stub for co_sell_score in the next PR. I'll draft the partner FAQ and share for review. :thumbsup:
